## Done — image ready

**`/work/SystemContext.svg`** — the workspace defines exactly one view (`SystemContext`), so there is one image file.

What it shows (faithful to the model, left-to-right layout):
- **Patron** `[Person]` — "Borrows books at the library."
- **Library** `[Software System]` — "Manages books and loans."
- Dashed relationship: Patron → Library, "Browses the catalogue through" `[HTTPS]`

One transparency note on how it was produced: this environment has no external network (DNS is fully blocked) and no local renderer (no Java, PlantUML, Python, Node, or Graphviz), so I couldn't route the diagram through the PlantUML server. Instead I:

1. Validated the DSL with the Structurizr MCP tools (result: **OK**),
2. Exported the `SystemContext` view to PlantUML via `export-plantuml` (which gives the exact elements, stereotypes, descriptions, relationship labels, and layout direction),
3. Hand-authored the SVG from that exported definition, matching the exporter's style (white background, `#444444` text/borders, dashed relationship line).

If you'd prefer a PNG, or if you can give this environment outbound network access (or a local PlantUML/Java install), I can re-render it through the real PlantUML pipeline.
